newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures close mostly lower on weak cash.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures close mostly lower on weak cash.

text.p: CME lumber futures traded in a wide range before closing lower on continued pressure from a weak cash market, traders said.
Lumber closed mostly $3.30 to $0.20 lower, with July down most at $371.30 per tbf and September off $0.50 at $365.00.

Early shortcovering lacked follow through and prices tumbled around midday on renewed pressure from the weak undertone to cash. Shortcovering developed again late to turn most months higher, traders said.
Random Lengths quoted cash spruce at $372 per tbf, off $3 from midweek and unchanged from last week's level.
Most cash sources put cash spruce around $10 under the official quote. Production remains high and demand only spotty, they said.
